title: Canonical named-root release writes its audit in a second lock hold and can claim a retirement the automatic pass made
outcome: Canonical named-root release writes its audit in a second lock hold and can claim a retirement the automatic pass made
acceptance: A canonical operator release never runs alongside the automatic reclamation pass for the same store, and its audit attributes only a retirement the release itself performed; a test covers the concurrent case.
A canonical release's retirement and its audit are committed together, or the audit is documented as best-effort for that route.
